beats.summary: Dwight shows Jim a Certificate of Bravery from the Scranton Police Department.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Certificate of Bravery, from the Scranton Police Department. "Recognizing outstanding citizenship from a very brave young man. Dwight K. Schrute"
Jim: Wow. I guess word got around. That's a nice… honor.

beats.summary: Michael and Jan negotiate Michael's raise with Jan insisting Michael ask for 15% so she can record it, but only offering 12%.

evidence.snippet: Jan: Okay, Michael. I can offer you a 12% raise, but you have got to ask for 15.
Michael: Ah, so… All right, Levinson. Here's the rub. I would like a 15% raise.

beats.summary: Angela suggests reading tales of bravery together with Dwight, and they share a kiss.
Andy returns from anger management and announces his comeback to the office.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I graduated from anger management the same way I graduated from Cornell. On time.
Andy: Hey guys! Guess who's back! AHHH! OH, GOD!

beats.summary: Dwight pepper-sprays Andy upon his return, causing Andy to scream in pain.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: No need to thank me.
